Dear Actief Interim Oostkamp team,

I am writing to apply for the Warehouse Worker - Night Shift position at your client in Oostkamp. I have warehouse experience from my recent role at Katoen Natie in Antwerp, where I worked in a high-volume logistics environment. I am comfortable operating electrical pallet trucks and am not afraid of cold environments. I am a night owl and prefer working night shifts.

I already live in Belgium (Zwijndrecht) and have my own transportation to Oostkamp. I have legal permission to work in Belgium. I am eager to join a stable logistics company and am open to internal training, including reach truck training.

I am available to start immediately. Please find my CV attached. I would be happy to discuss my application further.

Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,

Baver Ok

Dear Actief Interim Oostkamp team,

I am excited to apply for the Warehouse Worker - Night Shift position at your client in Oostkamp. With recent warehouse experience at Katoen Natie in Antwerp, I am well-prepared to contribute to your logistics team. I am comfortable operating electrical pallet trucks and have experience in high-volume, fast-paced environments. I am not afraid of cold environments and am specifically seeking a night shift role, as I am most productive during those hours.

I already live in Belgium (Zwijndrecht) and have my own transportation to Oostkamp, so I can start immediately. I have legal permission to work in Belgium. I am eager to join a stable employer with long-term opportunities and am open to internal training, including reach truck training.

In my previous warehouse role, I maintained accuracy and efficiency, ensuring that operations ran smoothly. I am a reliable and hardworking individual who values teamwork and safety. I am also comfortable with quality checks and keeping the warehouse organized.
